modules.name: GENRA Generative Sequencer
modules.description: Genre-aware generative sequencer: 8 drum voices, bass, melody and polyphonic pads with shared chord progressions

modules.name: GENRA Grid Editor
modules.description: Grid editor for GENRA: drum grid, piano roll and velocity lane for every track, docks next to GENRA

modules.name: ABLAUF Song Arranger
modules.description: Song arranger for GENRA: 64 pattern places in 4 banks, a song list with bars, parts, track mutes and fills, one button per song part that turns the playing pattern into an intro, build, drop, break or outro

modules.name: JIANT VOICE
modules.description: The JIANT FM firmware's VOICE engine: a formant singer (vowels, and words in Spanish, English and Japanese, your own lyrics), its vocal tract drawn live

modules.name: JIANT DRUM-X
modules.description: The JIANT FM firmware's DRUM-X drum synth: 8 synthesized sounds with A/B morph, 9 kits, individual outputs, its kit of creatures drawn live

modules.name: JIANT ANIMAL
modules.description: The JIANT FM firmware's ANIMAL engine: animal calls from physical models (CMOS bird machine, cricket pulses, syrinx whistle, wing tones, glottis), with its creature drawn live

modules.name: MONK
modules.description: MONK-1's formant vocal synth (MonkSynth): twelve singers, five vowels, choir, vibrato and stereo echo, the singer drawn live

modules.name: GENRA MONO
modules.description: Monophonic bass synth after the Moog Minitaur: two morphing oscillators, eight filter models (ladder, diode, MS-20, SEM, OTA), two ADSRs, LFO

modules.name: SCHMELZ
modules.description: String machine in the spirit of the 70s/80s: morphing strings registration with octaves and ensemble, a polyphonic solo section (bass, e-piano, clavi, synth, bell), animate, phaser and reverb

modules.name: FUNKE
modules.description: Melody voice for GENRA's melody track: 8 models (Rhodes, organ, bell, marimba, pluck, square, saw lead, flute), the 8 filters of GENRA MONO, glide on SLIDE, accent, delayed vibrato, lo-fi, chorus, clocked echo, reverb

modules.name: MIX
modules.description: 4-track stereo mixer for GENRA's tracks: shelf EQ, pan, level, mute/solo, two send/return loops, ducking from the kick, width, drive

modules.name: K-WASUB
modules.description: The K-WASUB firmware's modern bass synth (Omnipotard, GPL-3.0): 9 engines per oscillator (analog, 808, CS, wavetable, FM, growl, additive, phase distortion, hard sync), 7 filters, wobble on the tempo, 97 presets

modules.name: K-WASUB FX
modules.description: Effects expander for K-WASUB: saturation, crush, chorus, phaser, delay, reverb, compressor with pump, multiband, 4-band EQ, master

modules.name: UMLAUF
modules.description: Orbit vector synth, the engine of VADER by L'Cronx (MIT): an orbiter travels 50 shapes or 27 simulations between four corners, each VADER's overtone generators, one of 14 voices or a sample; CV for the orbiter, the corners' weights and each corner alone

modules.name: UMLAUF FX
modules.description: Expander for UMLAUF: envelope, unison, glide, vibrato, tremolo, the arpeggiator with a 16-step pattern, drive, chorus, delay, reverb, master

modules.name: STOTTER Performance FX
modules.description: DJ-style performance effects: 16 pads (stutter, halftime, reverse, tape stop, scratch, gates, echo out, freeze, bitcrush, rearrange) launched on the beat, isolator EQ with kills, DJ filter, MIDI
